config.phase: Relative-time output representation with exact decoding; policy facts and economic choices unchanged by serializer
config.input_changes: Same frozen 96 v3 contexts and shared v4 fact labeling. Remove legacy output-shape footer only. New root fields encode home endpoints and positive time gaps; decoder only adds minutes and formats HH:MM, never repairs choices or overflow.
config.schema: Allowed field types, exact anchor enum, home/work/category consistency, no-workplace when none supplied, event count bounds. No spending values, policy-specific actions or expected treatment effects.
config.primary: >=95% native first-response validity AND exact-decoded absolute schedule validity under the same 6-10 events, >=20 minute gaps, home endpoints, allowed anchors and category contract. Zero request failures; factual screens reviewed separately.
config.selection: Do not compare native raw format to the old raw JSON as if identical representations. Promote only after disjoint-person confirmation and controlled factual stress tests. No macro winner from this screen.
config.stop_rule: Generate all 96 cells once with seed 3701. No retries or timing edits. Overflow is failure, never clipped.
config.prohibitions: P010 immutable; P015 not run; no empirical outcome numbers or policy-specific direction in universal instructions. Known cases remain development data.
